prompt_protocol: Qwen3 chat template, enable_thinking=False, official RULER answer prefix appended in assistant turn
length_definition: prompt tokens including chat template and answer prefix + task max_gen_toks <= nominal length
subset_protocol: uniform permutation without replacement, nested 10 subset 50 subset 100
qa_protocol: 100 uniformly drawn answerable dev questions without replacement; identical source IDs across lengths
parallel_protocol: Independent data-parallel vLLM replicas; GPU 1 evaluates 4k/8k/16k, GPU 3 evaluates 32k; no tensor parallelism or RoPE modification
